spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "scraper_health" and r._field == "ok")
    |> group()
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, failed: if r._value then 0 else 1, run: if r._value then 0 else 1}))
    |> difference(columns: ["run"], keepFirst: true)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with run: if exists r.run and r.run == 0 then 0 else 1}))
    |> cumulativeSum(columns: ["run"])
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.failed == 1)
    |> group(columns: ["run"])
    |> reduce(
        identity: {_time: 2200-01-01T00:00:00Z, _end: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, n: 0},
        fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
            _time: if r._time < accumulator._time then r._time else accumulator._time,
            _end: if r._time > accumulator._end then r._time else accumulator._end,
            n: accumulator.n + 1,
        }),
    )
    |> group()
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,
        _end: r._end,
        text: "Scrape failing: " + string(v: r.n) + " consecutive failed scrape(s)",
        tags: "outage,auto",
    }))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "scraper_health" and r._field == "rows_parsed")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000000.0, _field: "last_scrape_age_seconds"}))

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_scoreboard" and r._field == "queue_running_percent")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.team_id and r.team_id =~ /^${team_id:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["display_name"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r.display_name}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

names = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_scoreboard" and r._field == "rank")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.team_id and r.team_id =~ /^${team_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.submission_type or r.submission_type =~ /^${submission_type:regex}$/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "team_id", "display_name"])
  |> group(columns: ["team_id", "display_name"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {first_seen: now(), last_seen: time(v: 0)},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      first_seen: if r._time < accumulator.first_seen then r._time else accumulator.first_seen,
      last_seen: if r._time > accumulator.last_seen then r._time else accumulator.last_seen
    })
  )
  |> group(columns: ["team_id"])

nameStatus = names
  |> reduce(
    identity: {has_name: false},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({has_name: accumulator.has_name or r.display_name != r.team_id})
  )

join(tables: {names: names, status: nameStatus}, on: ["team_id"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.display_name != r.team_id or not r.has_name)
  |> drop(columns: ["has_name"])
  |> group(columns: ["team_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["first_seen", "display_name"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {name_count: 0, names: ""},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      name_count: accumulator.name_count + (if r.display_name == r.team_id then 0 else 1),
      names: accumulator.names + (if accumulator.names == "" then "" else " • ") + r.display_name
    })
  )
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["name_count", "team_id"], desc: true)

spec.description: Distinct scoreboard display names per stable team ID across all retained data in the selected semester bucket, independent of the dashboard time range. Respects the teamID and submission_type filters. An ID-only label is shown only when no other name is observed for that team within these filters, and contributes zero to the distinct name count. Reusing a previous name does not increase the count; the name list is ordered by first observation, not a sequence of every rename.
spec.title: Team Name Summary

spec.query:
names = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "team_scoreboard" and r._field == "rank")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.team_id and r.team_id =~ /^${team_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.submission_type or r.submission_type =~ /^${submission_type:regex}$/)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "team_id", "display_name"])
  |> group(columns: ["team_id", "display_name"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {first_seen: now(), last_seen: time(v: 0)},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      first_seen: if r._time < accumulator.first_seen then r._time else accumulator.first_seen,
      last_seen: if r._time > accumulator.last_seen then r._time else accumulator.last_seen
    })
  )
  |> group(columns: ["team_id"])

nameStatus = names
  |> reduce(
    identity: {has_name: false},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({has_name: accumulator.has_name or r.display_name != r.team_id})
  )

join(tables: {names: names, status: nameStatus}, on: ["team_id"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.display_name != r.team_id or not r.has_name)
  |> drop(columns: ["has_name"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["team_id", "first_seen", "display_name"])

spec.description: One row per stable team ID and distinct scoreboard display name across all retained data in the selected semester bucket, independent of the dashboard time range. Respects the teamID and submission_type filters. First/last observed are scrape timestamps, not exact rename times. Repeated uses of the same name share one row and may include gaps. Anonymous teams without a stable ID are excluded. An ID-only label is included only when no other name is observed for that team within these filters.

spec.definition:
import "strings"

buckets()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.name =~ /^scoreboard-(ss|ws)[0-9]{4}$/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.name, semester: strings.substring(v: r.name, start: 13, end: 17) + (if strings.hasPrefix(v: r.name, prefix: "scoreboard-ws") then "1" else "0")}))
  |> sort(columns: ["semester"], desc: true)
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
